summary: [Intercom] webhooks: envelope {type:"notification_event", id, topic, app_id, created_at, delivery_attempts, data:{item}}. Topics: conversation.user.created/.user.replied/.admin.replied/.admin.assigned, contact.user.created, contact.lead.created, ticket.created, "ping" handshake. Sign: X-Hub-Signature = "sha1=" + hex(HMAC-SHA1(raw body, client_secret)); verify raw bytes timing-safe. Respond 200 within 5s; repeated errors -> 15-min drop.
